## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, lint, format, tests)
- [ ] Tests added or updated (a bug fix includes a test that fails without it)
- [ ] Docs, examples and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if behaviour or the API changed
- [ ] No tokens, session files, `.har` files or real personal data in the change
- [ ] Doesn't weaken pacing, duplicate protection, or the photo and session safeguards
